scope: Owner-review gate for the proposed ShipDeck lifecycle producer after T-FO06CQ

producerHandoff.requiredPath: reviewed single server/protocol producer -> GlobalMotionShipDeckPassengerLifecycleCoordinator.TryAccept -> coordinator receipt and generations -> typed coordinator mapping/handoff -> GlobalMotionShipDeckCombinedTransactionHost

NpcShipController.role: server ship registration/despawn seam and candidate boundary
NpcShipController.reason: Does not own stable protocol ShipId, coordinator lifetime generation, all passenger phases, strict ledger order or unified terminal invalidation; NetworkObjectId-derived npcInstanceId is not protocol identity.

ShipCrewSpawner.role: server crew spawn/reuse/despawn-map seam and passenger ingress candidate
ShipCrewSpawner.reason: Spawn/reuse does not prove completed attach or detach and the spawner does not own stable passenger identity, ship/attachment generations, coordinator order or terminal invalidation.

NpcBrain.role: server explicit attach/detach local completion seam
NpcBrain.reason: Local attachment state and references do not provide stable passenger protocol identity, coordinator-issued attachment generation, ship lifetime lineage, cross-phase order or unified terminal ownership.

ShipDeckNav.reason: NavMesh lifecycle is not protocol lifecycle ownership; RegistrationGeneration is NavMesh-only and cannot become ShipId, lifetime generation, attachment generation or ledger ordinal.

GlobalMotionShipDeckCombinedTransactionH.role: downstream reviewed binding and transaction consumer
GlobalMotionShipDeckCombinedTransactionH.reason: Host consumes coordinator-produced typed receipts and must not become a lifecycle source owner.

phaseOwnerEvidence.requiredOwnerEvidence: One server/protocol owner proves accepted registration for explicit stable ShipId, server/protocol ownership and a new lifetime boundary. Coordinator issues never-reused ShipLifetimeGeneration and first LedgerOrdinal.

The same owner proves stable passenger identity, matching accepted ship lifetime, completed NpcBrain attachment, ready ShipDeckNav evidence and server/protocol ownership. Coordinator issues the new AttachmentGeneration and next LedgerOrdinal.

The same owner proves completed server detach for the exact active coordinator attachment epoch, matching ship lifetime, passenger identity and attachment generation. Coordinator closes the epoch; no synthetic generation is created.

The same owner proves one terminal server/protocol invalidation for the exact active ship lifetime with explicit reason, terminal ledger ordering and accounting for open passenger epochs. Coordinator clears active generations and rejects every later fact.

nextGate: Obtain explicit owner evidence for one complete four-phase server/protocol producer, then perform a separate implementation and typed binding review; do not synthesize missing facts.
